summary: A magical coloring app featuring Frozen, Disney Princesses, Stitch, and more!
description:
Disney Coloring World offers a magical and creative experience for children and fans of all ages, featuring beloved characters from Frozen, Disney Princesses, Mickey, Stitch, Pixar, Star Wars, Marvel, and more!

• Over 2,000 coloring pages with your favorite Disney characters.

• A rainbow of art tools, including brushes, crayons, glitter, patterns, and stamps.

• Enjoy the Magic Color tool that lets you color in perfectly!

• Dress up characters by creating and mixing outfits.

• Decorate magical locations like Arendelle Castle from Frozen.

• Play in enchanting 3D playsets, filled with interactive surprises.

• Develop creativity, fine motor skills, art skills, and confidence.

• Enjoy a calming and therapeutic experience.

• It's not just coloring—it's creating your own Disney magic!

CHARACTERS

Frozen (including Elsa, Anna, and Olaf), Lilo & Stitch, Disney Princesses (including Moana, Ariel, Rapunzel, Belle, Jasmine, Aurora, Tiana, Cinderella, Mulan, Merida, Snow White, Pocahontas, and Raya), Mickey & Friends (including Minnie Mouse, Donald Duck, Daisy, Pluto, and Goofy), Wish, Encanto, Toy Story, Lion King, Villains, Cars, Elemental, Monsters Inc., The Incredibles, Winnie the Pooh, Inside Out, Wreck-It-Ralph, Vampirina, Turning Red, Finding Nemo, Aladdin, The Good Dinosaur, Luca, Elena of Avalor, Coco, Zootopia, Peter Pan, Doc McStuffins, WALL·E, Sofia The First, Puppy Dog Pals, Whisker Haven, Ratatouille, Pinocchio, Alice in Wonderland, A Bug’s Life, Big Hero 6, 101 Dalmatians, Strange World, Lady and the Tramp, Bambi, Dumbo, Aristocats, Up, Onward, Soul, Nightmare Before Christmas, Phineas and Ferb, Muppets, and more.

AWARDS & ACCOLADES

• Kidscreen 2025 Nominee for Best Game App – Branded
• Apple’s Editor’s Choice 2022
• Kidscreen - Shortlisted for Best Game/App 2022

FEATURES

• Safe and age-appropriate.
• Designed responsibly to let your child enjoy screen time while developing healthy digital habits at a young age.
• FTC Approved COPPA Safe Harbor Certification by Privo.
• Play pre-downloaded content offline without wifi or internet.
• Regular updates with new content.
• No third-party advertising.
• No in-app purchases for subscribers.
• Supports Google Stylus.

SUPPORT

ABOUT STORYTOYS
 
Our mission is to bring the world's most popular characters, worlds, and stories to life for children. We make apps for kids that engage them in well-rounded activities designed to help them learn, play, and grow. Parents can enjoy peace of mind knowing their kids are learning and having fun at the same time.

PRIVACY & TERMS
 
StoryToys takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps comply with privacy laws, including the Child Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). If you would like to learn more about the information we collect and how we use it, please visit our privacy policy at https://storytoys.com/privacy.

Read our terms of use here: https://storytoys.com/terms.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS

While you are subscribed you can play with EVERYTHING. We regularly add new stuff, so subscribed users will enjoy ever-expanding play opportunities.

Google Play does not permit in-app purchases and free apps to be shared via Family Library. Therefore, any purchases you make in this app will NOT be shareable via Family Library.
